In fact, one of the most compelling cases illustrating this point comes from research on renal infarction with inflammatory syndrome. This condition often involves PAN and can lead to spontaneous resolution of symptoms without the need for treatment.

While PAN itself does not have a well-established mechanism for inducing remission, its potential impact on other conditions cannot be ignored. For instance, in some cases, PAN may play a role in various autoimmune disorders or other inflammatory processes, potentially leading to an improvement in symptoms over time without external intervention.
